subject: Cross-border data residency: tech review & scheduling
messages:
From: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@nordbank.de>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T15:02:00Z
Subject: Request: architecture deep-dive (EU/US/APAC residency)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team at NordBank is interested in going deeper on deployment options and data residency. We need an architecture-level session focused on EU data residency controls, routing and fallback into US/APAC zones, and KMS/HSM integrations for our regulated workloads.

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute technical review in the next week or two? Our initial availability windows (CEST):
- Tue Oct 6: 09:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed Oct 7: 10:00–13:00

If those don't work, please propose alternatives. Attendees from our side: myself (architecture lead), Tom Harris (platform lead), and legal/infosec may join for the last 15 minutes.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Müller
Lead Cloud Architect — NordBank AG
[Attachment: nordbank-expected-constraints.pdf (PDF, 280KB)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@nordbank.de>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T17:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: architecture deep-dive (EU/US/APAC residency)

Hi Anna — great to hear, and happy to run this. Thanks for the windows.

Quick note on attendees: I want to include Dylan (serving/runtime lead) and Rishi (security & product compliance) so we can cover latency tradeoffs, routing/fallback policies, and KMS options end-to-end. Does Tue Oct 6 at 14:00 CEST work for you and Tom? If legal/infosec want to dial in for the final 15 minutes we can reserve that slot.

Pre-reads: I'll circulate a short draft architecture deck and an agenda beforehand. Dylan/Rishi — can you confirm availability for Oct 6 14:00 CEST (which is 08:00 ET / 21:00 SGT)? If that window is hard for Rishi, propose an alternate that keeps an overlapping window with EU morning.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: placeholder - will send deck before call]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: architecture deep-dive (EU/US/APAC residency)

Hey Evelyn — I'm available Oct 6 at 14:00 CEST. A couple of things I want to cover:
- Proposed routing policy: EU-primary with synchronous write-through to EU KMS; async replicate to APAC/US for read-only caches.
- KV cache behaviour for cross-region failover and estimated token-latency impact.
- Quantization/instance sizing tradeoffs for Dedicated vs Private.

I'll attach a one-pager with suggested agenda items and a short availability matrix. Also note that 21:00 SGT is late for our APAC contacts; if NordBank expects many APAC stakeholders we should consider moving to Oct 7 morning CEST (which is still workable).

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Serving Runtime Lead — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: dylan-availability-quick.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@nordbank.de>, Tom Harris <tharris@retailco.com>

Date: 2026-10-01T20:00:00Z
Subject: Scheduled: Cross-border data residency technical review — Oct 6, 14:00 CEST (60m)

Hi Anna / Tom — confirmed for Tue Oct 6 at 14:00 CEST (60 minutes) with an optional 15-minute legal/infosec extension at the end. Calendar invite and dial-in link below: 
https://calendar.redwood.com/event/evh-49821

Agenda (high level):
- 0–10m: Introductions & objectives (Anna/Tom)
- 10–30m: Deployment topology options (EU-primary, multi-zone replication)
- 30–50m: Security & KMS/HSM patterns, audit logs, and key separation
- 50–60m: Rollout/operational considerations, fallbacks, and cost tradeoffs
- 60–75m: Legal/infosec Q&A (optional)

Attachments: residency-review-agenda.pdf; residency-arch-draft.pptx (draft architecture slides)

Please review the deck ahead of the call — it contains a couple of example topologies and the routing policy matrix. Rishi will spend the first 10 minutes on KMS boundaries and audit log retention options.

See you Tuesday,
Evelyn

Thanks — that timing works for our core team. Two quick asks before the session:
1) Can you add a 15-minute pre-call with our legal/infosec immediately before the main session? They'll want to confirm audit log retention and key custody expectations; 13:30–13:45 CEST would be ideal.
2) I'm attaching our completed SOC2 questionnaire answers for reference; Rishi, can you flag any gaps you see so we can cover them in the Q&A?

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Anna
